description: Independent span-level literal controls; provider responses must preserve each source key meaning. Literal controls validate mapping/formatting, not live model quality.

cases.source: Please **check the schedule** before the meeting tomorrow.
cases.expectedDisplay: 请 **核对日程表** ，在明天开会前。
cases.meaning: Bold remains the checking action and schedule object; tomorrow/before-the-meeting remains outside bold.

cases.source: Before the meeting tomorrow, please **check the schedule**.
cases.expectedDisplay: 明天开会前，请 **核对日程表**.
cases.meaning: The time clause stays in range 1; bold remains the checking action and schedule object.

cases.source: Please read [the updated schedule](https://example.com/schedule) before the meeting tomorrow.
cases.expectedDisplay: 请阅读 [更新后的日程表](https://example.com/schedule) ，在明天开会前。
cases.meaning: The link label is the updated schedule, not the time clause. Destination is byte-identical.

cases.source: Please check the schedule **before the meeting tomorrow**.
cases.expectedDisplay: 请核对日程表 **在明天开会前**.
cases.meaning: The time condition, not checking the schedule, is bold.

cases.source: Please **do not publish** the draft before Friday.
translations: 这份草稿，在星期五之前。
cases.expectedDisplay: 请 **不要发布** 这份草稿，在星期五之前。
cases.meaning: Negation stays with publish in the bold range; draft and before-Friday restriction stay outside.

cases.source: We will **send the final report** after the review is complete.
cases.expectedDisplay: 我们会 **发送最终报告** ，待审核完成后。
cases.meaning: Action and report remain bold; review completion stays outside as the preceding condition.

cases.source: Please **check the schedule** and then **check the schedule** again.
cases.expectedDisplay: 请 **核对日程表** 然后 **核对日程表** ，再来一次。
cases.meaning: Repeated source text has distinct range IDs and both bold occurrences survive without deduplication.

cases.source: She said **her report is ready** before she left.
translations: 她的报告已经准备好了
cases.expectedDisplay: 她说 **她的报告已经准备好了** 在她离开之前。
cases.meaning: Her possessive report remains inside bold; outer speaking and departure clauses retain she, with no person/ownership swap.
